title: Petition of Fitchburg Gas and Electric Light Company, pursuant to G.L. c. 164, § 14, (1) for approval to issue and sell up to $19,000,000 of long-term notes; (2) for approval to incorporate the costs associated with the redemption of certain outstanding note issues and the remaining unamortized debt expenses relating to said issues as a portion of the cost of the new financing, to be amortized over the life of the proposed issue; and (3) for an exemption from the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 15.
petitioner: Fitchburg Gas and Electric Light Company d/b/a Unitil
